result.title: State-Augmented Learning for Post-Deployment Adaptation of Coexisting O-RAN Applications
result.comment: submitted to IEEE Transactions on Mobile Computing
result.summary: Fixed control policies in Open RAN can require retraining when service requirements, traffic loads, or interacting applications change. We propose ATTUNE, a state-augmented learning method for an energy saving application that coexists with a learned mobility load balancing application under a service constraint. ATTUNE conditions the energy saving policy on a Lagrange multiplier and updates this scalar during operation using measured service degradation, while keeping both applications' network parameters fixed. To train a single policy across service requirements, ATTUNE samples target service levels uniformly and maps them to multipliers through an adaptive table. This procedure accounts for policy-dependent multiplier responses and improves energy savings compared with training over a widened fixed multiplier range. We characterize the induced distribution of service levels and the convergence and fluctuations of the online update. An exact finite-window identity establishes convergence of average measured degradation to the target when the projection corrections vanish on average. Simulations show that a single ATTUNE policy achieves energy savings comparable to policies trained separately for each service requirement. It adapts to changes in the target, load, and partner application without retraining, increases energy savings at light load, and maintains target tracking for separately trained application pairs. No statistically significant increase in cell switching is detected in the evaluated comparisons.

AI.brief_summary: 面向 O-RAN 中节能应用与移动负载均衡应用共存的场景，提出 ATTUNE：把节能策略条件化在 Lagrange 乘子上，运行时依据实测服务退化在线更新该标量，并以均匀采样目标服务等级、经自适应表映射到乘子的方式训练单一策略，配合收敛性与波动分析及仿真验证免重训适配。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「用一个在线更新的标量条件化单一策略、以逼近目标约束而非固定超参」的构造，可能与 LVR 中按目标代价/精度预算调节计算量、动态停止（STOP）和跨预算的单一策略训练形成类比，可供核查其目标追踪与稳定性论证能否迁移。
